findings.location: Core statements; Research question and method
findings.finding: Both quotations resolve in the source. The PRISMA-guided review searched five named sources, screened 122 full documents and subjected 45 documents to full-text analysis; its synthesis reports 12 main ethical issues and 19 sub-issues.

The broad healthcare-AI ethics taxonomy and source-reported strategies support KI_Sonstige, Bias_Ungleichheit and Fairness. The document correctly excludes generative AI, prompting, social work and feminist methodology.

The September 2020 search boundary, mixture of academic and grey literature, and non-evaluative status of most strategies are grounded. Tables are linearised and Figure 1 is only captioned, but no reviewed claim depends on unread visual values.
